scored_by: agent eye-check of the ocr_run review sample

wrong_examples.why: Circular dichroism spectrum (theta_M deg cm2/dmol vs wavelength 180-300 nm); the '200' tick plus '(deg' matched the 2-theta pattern
Angle-resolved optical transmittance map (wavelength vs 'Incident angle (deg)'); '20' tick + '(deg)' matched 2-theta
Angle-resolved external quantum efficiency map ('Angle (deg)' vs wavelength), no diffraction pattern
UPS: He I secondary-electron cutoff with '21.2 eV', E_vac/E_VB markers, binding energy 20 to -5 eV, not a core-level XPS scan
EDX/EDS spectrum: axis is 0-4 keV (above any Al/Mg K-alpha source), C/N/Mo/W emission lines, mislabelled 'Binding Energy (keV)'
Optical/PL emission series vs 'Photon Energy (eV)' 2.2-3.4 eV (optical range, not an absorption edge)
Optical spectra 1.75-2.80 eV, no edge/XANES structure
Fluorescence/emission intensity vs wavelength 580-700 nm with a photon-energy top axis
UV-vis absorbance vs wavelength; only the Tauc inset carries 'Photon energy (eV)'
Schematic cavity-mode emission comb vs unlabelled 'Photon energy'
Electroluminescence spectra vs photon energy 1.5-3 eV
Cathodoluminescence spectrum, 1.8-2.5 eV
Photoluminescence intensity vs photon energy 3.1-3.5 eV
Transient absorption dT/T0 vs photon energy 1.6-2.4 eV (ultrafast optical, not X-ray)
Panel is an electrical-conductivity bar chart; the 'Raman shift (cm-1)' token is clipped bleed from the neighbouring panel at the top crop edge
Raman spectrum of MoS2 (E2g/A1g modes, 250-450 cm-1) with the x-axis written as 'Wavenumber (cm-1)'
Relative-intensity spectrum with narrow bands 400-1700 cm-1 (biomass Raman), not an IR transmittance/absorbance trace
Single sharp 236.8 cm-1 line, relative intensity, 150-500 cm-1 - low-frequency Raman, below normal FTIR range
Graphene oxide D and G bands at ~1350/1580 cm-1, intensity axis - Raman
Bar chart of cell viability vs power density (W/cm2); no image of a sample. Axis tick text like '0.5'/'1.25' plus a unit was read as a scale bar.
Acoustic-emission spectra, intensity vs frequency (kHz). The annotation 'Grain Size d=48um' / 'd=69um' inside the plot was read as a scale bar.
Bar chart of H2 evolution rate; the category labels are wavelengths ('>420 nm', '365 nm', '450 nm') and the 'nm' tokens fired the scale-bar rule.
bar chart, axis numbers+unit read as scale bar
AE frequency spectrum, 'Grain Size d=48um' caption read as scale bar
bar chart with wavelength ('nm') category labels
XAS/XANES Ru K-edge absorption spectrum, 22.10-22.20 keV. A keV x-axis is not sufficient: hard-X-ray absorption edges use the same unit.
AFM software screenshot: surface/horiz/vert distance measurement table over a height profile, not a composition profile.
Bar chart, zone-of-inhibition Distance [mm] vs E. coli concentration; microbiology, not composition.
Filopodial length / total extension distance (um) vs time (min); cell-biology kinetics.
Nanoscratch test: depth (um) and friction vs scratch distance (mm); mechanical, not composition.
Confocal PL schematic plus a polar intensity plot; only a stray 'Distance (nm)' token from a neighbouring panel.
Conductivity vs gate voltage transfer curve; the annotation 'Channel Distance = 10.5 um' fired the rule.
Interparticle distance (nm) vs polymer Mw, with TEM insets; distance is the y value, not a scan axis.
Grain-boundary migration distance (um) vs 1/G driving force, plus micrograph strips.
EBSD misorientation profile (degrees) vs distance [microns]; a line profile but of orientation, not composition.
CVD tube-furnace schematic with a 'Distance' dimension arrow; no plot at all.
Modulus E (GPa) and yield stress (MPa) vs Distance (um) through a graded tissue; mechanical profile.
Distance from centerline (mm) vs solidification parameter G^3/R; casting model, not a scan.
Piezoresistive sensor response: dR/R0 (%) vs Strain (%). Electrical readout, not a stress-strain or hardness plot; cue fired on the bare 'Strain (%)' axis.
DIC/EBSD strain map image (colour overlay on grains, 'Strain (%)' colourbar). The panel is microscopy, not a mechanical test curve; cue fired on the colourbar label.

MISS of `mechanical`: a clean engineering stress-strain plot with 'Engineering Stress [MPa]' / 'Engineering Strain [%]' axes fully legible in the OCR boxes. Text-recoverable miss - the axis wording (bracketed units, 'Engineering') is not matched by the current pattern.

MISS of `micrograph`: colour-coded phase/orientation map of a grain (a1/a2/a3 regions). Plainly microscopy, but NOT text-recoverable - the only tokens are the phase labels, no scale bar or instrument text.
